item.summary: Visa, NBX, Tieto and IDT Finance have announced plans for a Visa Flex Card, slated for launch in 2027 as a debit card in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Germany, and later in Poland. Eligible NBX customers will be able to pay from fiat or supported stablecoin balances via Visa Flexible Credential. The announcement follows NBX's earlier agreement with Tieto on a stablecoin payment card.
